functions.name: strava_connect
functions.title: Strava connection
functions.description: Manage the signed-in user's Strava connection. Use action 'auth_url' to get the OAuth authorization URL to send the user to (requires redirect_uri); action 'connect' to exchange a returned OAuth code for tokens and store the connection (requires code + redirect_uri); action 'status' to check if Strava is connected; action 'disconnect' to remove the connection.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to auth_url when no code is provided.

redirect_uri.description: The exact redirect URI registered in the Strava app settings, same-origin absolute path. Required for auth_url and connect.

code.description: The OAuth authorization code returned by Strava to the redirect URI. Required for connect.

functions.name: strava_activities
functions.title: Strava activities
functions.description: Access the signed-in user's Strava activities. Use action 'list' to fetch the 30 most recent activities (distance, duration, elevation, GPS availability); action 'gpx' to reconstruct and return a GPX trace for one activity (requires activity_id, optional name). Requires a connected Strava account.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to list.

activity_id.description: Strava activity id. Required for gpx.

name.description: Optional name to embed in the generated GPX file.
